title: Continuous-Time Quantum Walk on Locally Infinite Graph
summary: Time-reversal symmetry is of fundamental importance to physics. In the classical theory of time-reversal symmetry, the time-reversal symmetry of a quantum system is described by an anti-unitary operator, which is known as the time-reversal operator of the system. In this paper, we introduce and study a model of continuous-time quantum walk on a special locally infinite graph. After examining its spectral property, we investigate the time-reversal symmetry of the model.
